**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

- **§ 8.2** — 12-month renewal terms, 30-day Customer non-renewal notice, 60-day Vendor reminder, plus a deadline extension if the reminder is missed. This is at (in fact slightly above) our preferred position.
- **§ 8.3** — Renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%, 90 days' notice, no increase on prepaid periods — matches our preferred cap.
- **§ 8.1** — Three-year master term, but it does not auto-renew and does not extend Order Form terms, so no walk-away multi-year auto-renewal risk.
